parole.significato: chador (loose robe worn by Muslim women)
parole.testo: Internationalism; compare English chador, French tchador, German Tschador, ultimately from Classical Persian چادر (čādar, čādur), from Sanskrit छत्त्र (chattra).

parole.significato: Tajik, Tajikistani (native or inhabitant of Tajikistan) (usually male)
